title: Nimzo-Indian Defense: Classical Variation
line: White's queen is ready to take back if the bishop takes the knight, so White's pawns stay whole.

steps.text: The Nimzo-Indian, and White brings the queen out. If the bishop takes the knight, the queen takes back.

steps.after: White pushes a pawn at the bishop.

steps.text: Take the knight with check before the bishop is chased away.
steps.after: The queen takes back. White has the two bishops and whole pawns, but it has spent time.

steps.text: Move the pawn on b7 one square, to make room for your bishop.
Put the bishop on the long diagonal. With the knight, it aims at e4.
steps.after: White spends a pawn move to guard e4.

steps.text: Ask the bishop on g5 what it wants. It is pinning your knight.
Now push the pawn in front of your queen two squares, into the center.
steps.after: Black has its share of the center.

summary: The queen takes back, so White's pawns stay whole. Black fights for the center square with its pieces.
